books.title: Mistborn: The Final Empire — Library edition
books.description: Full unabridged edition from Macmillan Audio, listed on OverDrive. Open the official page to borrow through a participating Libby library; a qualifying library card and availability are required. External listening only.

books.title: Mistborn: The Final Empire — Google Play
books.description: Complete unabridged Macmillan Audio audiobook, including a free preview through Google Play. Purchase or eligible access required for the full book. Not directly playable in AudioShelf.

books.title: Mistborn 1: The Final Empire — GraphicAudio, Part 1 of 3
books.description: Official dramatized adaptation, part 1 of 3, with a free sample at the provider. Purchase or provider entitlement required for the full audio. Open GraphicAudio for listening and format options.

books.title: Mistborn — Complete GraphicAudio Series Catalogue
books.description: Official GraphicAudio catalogue of Mistborn dramatizations (Era 1 and Era 2). Each full audiobook is licensed and may require separate purchase; this is a series catalogue, not a playable audiobook file.
